title: Guarantee Terms Commentary — Standing and True-Up of the Savings Guarantee under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Standing and True-Up of the Savings Guarantee

Commentary on the guarantee terms of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions, clause by clause.

## Clauses in force

**Standing.** A savings guarantee stands only at the tiers that carry one. Whether the tier carries a guarantee, the guaranteed percentage, the annual ceiling, the shortfall portion and the measurement and verification option are the figures fixed for the tier.

**True-up.** Measured savings are trued up at the tier's true-up frequency under the tier's measurement and verification option, comparing the period's use against the fixed baseline, weather normalised where the tier normalises. The verified savings for the subscription year are the savings verified on true-ups signed off from the first day of the term through its last day.

**Periods do not offset.** Savings above the guarantee in one period do not offset a shortfall in another unless the true-up is annual, in which case the year is measured as a whole.

**Changes outside the company's control.** A shortfall is not paid where the building's use changed outside the company's control — occupancy hours, added equipment or a change of tenant.

**Retrofit.** Where the tier resets the baseline on retrofit, the baseline is reset at the retrofit's close and the year's guarantee is prorated.

**Form of payment.** The payment is made as a credit against the subscription balance unless the owner asks for a cheque.

**Record a payment rests on.** A shortfall payment for a true-up period rests on the verification recorded for that period on this subscription — the verified savings and the guaranteed savings entered against that period and this subscription in the company's records — and never on the owner's own account of the period.

## Clause no longer in force

The following sentence is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for settling a shortfall; it is retained here only so that it is not applied:

> *A shortfall arises only where the verified savings for the true-up period fall below the guaranteed savings for that period, and the company then pays the tier's shortfall portion of the difference, up to the tier's annual guarantee ceiling and never beyond what remains of the year's guarantee.* — no longer in force, together with the arithmetic that accompanied it (the difference at the shortfall portion, held to the ceiling and to the guarantee remaining).

## Reading the offset clause

| True-up frequency | A surplus in one period against a shortfall in another |
|---|---|
| quarterly or semiannual | does not offset — each period stands alone |
| annual | the year is measured as a whole |

superseded_clauses: A shortfall arises only where the verified savings for the true-up period fall below the guaranteed savings for that period, and the company then pays the tier's shortfall portion of the difference, up to the tier's annual guarantee ceiling and never beyond what remains of the year's guarantee.
